item.title: The Controversial Nazca Mummies! Are they REAL ALIENS or NOT? (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Are the mysterious Nazca mummies evidence of extraterrestrial life, or could they be part of an elaborate hoax? Filmmaker and producer Darcy Weir joins anthropologist and archaeologist Dr. Joseph A. P. Wilson to explore one of the most controversial discoveries in recent years. With claims of non-human remains sparking worldwide debate, the mystery surrounding these unusual specimens continues to raise questions about their origins, authenticity, and what they could mean for our understanding of history.

Together, Weir and Wilson examine the extraordinary claims surrounding the Nazca mummies, including the controversial X-ray images, unusual anatomical features, and competing interpretations of the available evidence. Are these specimens something science has yet to explain, or is there a more conventional explanation? What evidence is credible, what remains questionable, and what scientific testing would be necessary to finally separate fact from fiction?

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
